errors.text: The proposed material is a BCC-based refractory HEA rather than the FCC+B2 AlCoCrFeNi2.1 eutectic HEA.

The predicted transition is primarily a function of aging time at one temperature, whereas the target transition occurs across an aging-temperature window, with embrittlement near 600°C and recovery near 750°C.
The hypothesis replaces the target L12 ordering and jagged B2/FCC phase-boundary mechanism with generic B2/Heusler precipitation, coarsening, and dissolution.
The cited evidence does not directly demonstrate the required correlation among chemical order, ductility minimum, and subsequent ductility recovery.
